claims.text:
irl-reward-transfer

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:irl-reward-transfer` → `ai-irl-reward-transfer` → `src/demos/ai/ai-irl-reward-transfer`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/119`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#15-irl-reward-transfer`. **Packet:** R2. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:inverse-rl-goal-inference`, `ai:behaviour-cloning-drift`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** inverse-rl-goal-inference scores compatible rewards; this tests a retained reward map under changed dynamics rather than replaying an old action sequence.

**Computed primary model:** Original grid nodesS(0,0),M(1,0),G(2,0),D(0,1),E(1,1),F(2,1), unit orthogonal edges. Reward10 on first reachingG, cost1 per attempted move, gamma1, horizon4. Original shortest policyS→M→G returns8. Clone action sequenceRight,Right. Block edgeM–G: replay ends atM after the blocked second attempt, return−2. Replan by BFS with same goal reward finds4-move pathS→M→E→F→G, return6 (tie orderRight,Down,Left,Up).

**Countercase / boundary:** A wrongly inferred goalE replans toE in2moves and receives inferred return8 but true G-return−2. Reward transfer only helps when reward/dynamics assumptions are suitable; this supplied reward is not uniquely recovered by IRL. No illegal move passes through a barrier.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether the old action sequence survives the wall change; recall changing inferred goal can spoil transfer even when replanning executes correctly.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Move wall computes blocked clone trace and shortest replanned trace in the same original schematic, with originalG path retained. Wrong goal shows inferred reward separately from true reward; keep cost/horizon and blocked attempted move visible.

**Source obligation:** Declared finite construction and reproduced arithmetic support only this toy. Independently derive every visible claim; acquire an original method body with exact locator before adding generalized performance, history or empirical assertions. Method lead: [Ng–Russell2000](https://ai.stanford.edu/~ang/papers/icml00-irl.pdf), not acquired here. No inference-identifiability theorem is added; reward compatibility and toy BFS are explicitly declared.
